prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: SealCode website logo, pixel-art revision v2, transparent PNG.
Input image 1: edit target, the previously approved direction of the pixel-art seal mascot. This is a refinement of this exact character, not a new character design.
Primary request: make this pixel-art logo slightly more detailed and dimensional through restrained shadows, stepped tonal transitions and highlights. Keep its minimalist personality and recognizable composition.
Preserve: the same frontal seated friendly grey seal, pose, body silhouette, left tail/flipper, two front flippers around a charcoal laptop, over-ear headphones, round dark eyes with small white highlights, pale muzzle, whiskers, and exact white code glyph "</>" on laptop. Keep proportions, overall placement, dark outlines and compact logo composition as close to the input as possible.
Style: polished authentic pixel art, coherent square-pixel grid, crisp stepped edges and intentional pixel clusters. Add 3–4 discrete bands of cool grey shading across the seal: soft light from upper left, gently lighter forehead and cheek, slightly darker right side and beneath the muzzle, subtle contact shading where the headphones meet the head and where the laptop overlaps the body. Add dimensional ear cushions, a few precise pixel highlights along the headphone arch, subtle bevels on the laptop rim and a darker lower corner. Use a restrained palette of approximately 10–14 cool greys, blue-grey neutrals and charcoal with white glyph highlights.
Tone transitions should be created by ordered contiguous pixel clusters, not blur. A small amount of selective dithering only where helpful, never noisy. Maintain generous clean color areas and legibility at 90px display width. Detail should support the existing shape, not clutter it.
Transparency: real fully transparent background outside the mascot AND in the gap between the headphone arch and head. The mascot itself should be opaque. NO floor shadow, drop shadow outside the silhouette, opaque backdrop, circle, badge, glow, halo, baked-in checkerboard or scene.
Composition: single centered complete mascot, approximately the same horizontal crop and margin as the input, whole headphones and flippers visible. No text outside the laptop, no labels, wordmark or watermark.
Avoid: smooth vector outlines, photorealism, 3D rendering, blurry airbrushed gradients, fur texture, excessive decorative pixels, new accessories or extra characters. Return one standalone transparent logo.
